name: mailbridge
description: Standalone Gmail API + Google OAuth 2.0 demo — React frontend, Express backend

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend

scripts.vercel-build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
